info.title: Creatomate Universal API
info.description: Create, render, and manage automated videos and images

post.description: Creates a concatenated video render in Creatomate.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

videoUrls[].description: Ordered list of video URLs to concatenate into one render.

includeFadeTransition.description: Whether to add the documented fade transition between clips after the first.

transitionDurationSeconds.description: Duration of the transition animation in seconds.

transitionType.description: Creatomate transition type to apply between video clips.

outputFormat.description: Output format requested for the render.

status.description: Current render status returned by Creatomate.

url.description: Direct URL for the rendered output file.
